question: Select the correct option for the band gap energies of Ge, Si and GaAs. Where E(Ge) = band gap energy of Ge, E(Si) = band gap energy of Si and E(GaAs) = band gap energy of GaAs
solution:
The correct answer is __E(GaAs) > E(Si) > E(Ge)****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Band gap energy__ is an important property of semiconductors.
 
• Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) has a higher band gap energy than Silicon (Si) and Germanium (Ge).
 
• Silicon (Si) has a higher band gap energy than Germanium (Ge).
 
• The order of band gap energies is E(GaAs) > E(Si) > E(Ge).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Typical Band Gap Values:**
 
 
• The band gap energy for Germanium (Ge) is approximately 0.67 eV.
 
• The band gap energy for Silicon (Si) is approximately 1.12 eV.
 
• The band gap energy for Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) is approximately 1.43 eV.
 
 
 
• **Band Gap Type:**
 
 
• GaAs is a direct band gap material, making it suitable for optoelectronic applications.
 
• Si and Ge are indirect band gap materials, commonly used in electronic devices.
